Ŏnŏcoetes , ae, m., = Ὀνοκοιτης,
I.he who lies in an ass's manger, a mocking epithet applied by the heathen to Christ, Tert. Apol. 16; cf. id. ad Nat. 1, 14 (al. Ŏnŏnychītes , ae, m., = Ὀνονυχίτης, he who has an ass's hoof, likewise applied to Christ).
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
